Student and partner conversations

Eight two-minute conversations. The student is on the left channel; the frozen audio-duplex partner is on the right. Headphones help separate them.

Starting checkpoints, before the new training run: pose-duplex student 211 and raw audio-duplex partner 253.

The student uses natural sampling. The partner uses Amu’s audio-duplex sampling settings. Pose was generated but is not rendered here. Each recording starts with its original 3–5-second prefill.
